title: TRIGGERBOT AIMBOT VISUALS + MORE
features:
🎯 Core Features
Aimbot

Enable / Disable toggle — pill-switch UI

Custom Aim Key — bind any keyboard key, mouse button, or touch input

Toggle Key — enable/disable aimbot with a hotkey mid-game

Smoothness slider (1–12) — higher = smoother glide, lower = snappier snap

Prediction slider (0–0.5) — leads moving targets by their velocity

FOV Size slider (30–600px) — adjustable aimbot target radius

Visual FOV Circle — on-screen ring showing active targeting range

Wall Check — raycast verification, won't lock through walls

Team Check — ignores teammates

Anti-spin math — viewport-center targeting with per-frame clamp (no upward snap bug)

Deadzone — 2px threshold prevents jitter when already on target

TriggerBot

Enable / Disable toggle

Toggle Key — hotkey bind

Delay slider (0–200ms) — reaction time before firing

Random Delay — randomized timing to feel human

Min / Max Delay sliders — bounds for randomization

Trigger FOV slider (5–50px) — crosshair detection radius

Visual Trigger FOV Circle — toggleable on-screen indicator

Wall Check — won't fire through walls

Team Check — skips teammates

Multi-part targeting — checks Head, UpperTorso, LowerTorso, HumanoidRootPart, Torso

Visuals — ESP

Highlight ESP — colorable player outline with depth mode AlwaysOnTop

Outline Transparency slider — 0 to 1

Fill Transparency slider — 0 to 1

Visuals — Skeleton ESP

Off by default ✅

R6 & R15 support — auto-detects rig type

Thickness slider (1–4px)

Transparency slider (0–1)

Drawing-based rendering — clean bone lines

Visuals — Tracers

Enable toggle

Transparency slider (0–1)

Center-screen origin — lines drawn from viewport center

Visuals — Health ESP

Enable toggle

Text Outline toggle

Dynamic color — green > yellow > red based on health %

Auto-updating text — shows current/max

Visuals — Name Tags

Enable toggle

Text Outline toggle

Gotham Bold font with player name

Visuals — World Time

Enable toggle

Time of Day slider (0–24h)

Auto-tunes Brightness, OutdoorAmbient, and Ambient per time period

Visuals — Aspect Ratio

Enable toggle

Ratio slider (0.5–1.5) — stretch or squish the camera

🎨 UI / UX Features
Theming System

6 preset themes: Violet, Crimson, Emerald, Cyber, Sunset, Mono

Live theme swapping — animated 0.4s color transition on every element

Custom theme builder — create unlimited themes with RGB sliders

Save / Load / Delete custom themes — persisted to InvalidX_Themes.json

RGB preview swatch on every color slider

Hex-style readout (r,g,b values) as you drag

Interface

Modern glass-morphism design — rounded cards, subtle gradients, soft borders

iOS-style pill toggles with animated knob sliding

Purple ring slider thumbs that grow on drag

Animated gradient logo with rotating shimmer

Auto-scaled UI — fits any viewport from 720p up

Draggable menu — click-and-drag any tab of the top bar

Smooth open/close animation — Quart easing with squash effect

Content card — all pages wrapped in a clean elevated panel

Gotham typography — Bold headers, Medium values, Regular body text

Notifications

Slide-in from right with Quart easing

Gradient icon circle matching the notification type

Vertical gradient accent bar on the left

Progress bar that drains over the notification's lifetime

Auto-dismiss with fade + slide-out

Color-coded — green success, red danger, theme-primary info

Fires on every toggle — "Aimbot — Enabled" etc.

Startup notifications — welcome + tip messages

Watermark

Top-left floating badge

Animated
